content.value_statement: Complex coding work often needs analysis, implementation, testing, and review in a fixed order. Stream-Chain helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code pass each result into the next workflow step.
actual_capabilities: Runs custom prompt chains where each step receives the previous step output.
Provides predefined analysis, refactor, test, and optimize pipelines.
Documents verbose, timeout, and debug options for chain runs.
Shows workflows for development, review, migration, and data transformation.
limitations: Requires a working claude-flow installation and configured project context.
Does not include executable implementation files; it documents how to use the CLI.
Prompt quality and context size affect the reliability of later steps.
Long chains can exceed timeouts and may need manual review.

use_cases.title: Plan Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: Create a sequence for requirements analysis, design, implementation, tests, and documentation.

use_cases.title: Improve Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Use chained prompts to inspect coverage, design missing cases, and prepare a focused test plan.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Debt
use_cases.description: Run analysis and refactor workflows to rank quality issues and define remediation priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Analysis Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Use stream-chain to create a two-step workflow that analyzes my project structure, then lists the top improvement areas.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Test Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a stream-chain workflow that reviews test coverage, proposes missing cases, and writes a prioritized test plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Refactor Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a stream-chain sequence for refactoring a legacy module. Include discovery, prioritization, implementation guidance, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Reusable Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a reusable stream-chain pipeline for security review, remediation planning, test generation, and final reporting.

output_examples.input: Analyze a new repository with the analysis pipeline.
output_examples.output: A staged report listing structure observations, quality issues, and prioritized recommendations.

output_examples.input: Create a code review workflow for recent changes.
output_examples.output: Sequential tasks for change analysis, issue detection, security checks, coverage review, and a final review report.

output_examples.input: Plan a migration assistant for an old frontend project.
output_examples.output: A migration checklist that identifies breaking changes, ranks risk, and defines validation steps.

best_practices: Write specific step prompts that name the files, goals, and expected result.
Place verification or review steps after generation steps.
Increase timeouts for analysis, migration, or implementation chains.
anti_patterns: Using vague prompts such as general quality checks without scope.
Chaining many unrelated tasks that cannot use previous results.
Treating generated changes as final without tests or review.

faq.question: Does this skill execute code by itself?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents stream-chain CLI workflows and prompt sequences.

faq.question: What tools is it meant for?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in projects that use Claude Flow.

faq.question: Can I define my own pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation describes reusable pipeline definitions in .claude-flow/config.json.

faq.question: Does each step see previous results?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow passes previous output into the next prompt.

faq.question: What predefined pipelines are described?
faq.answer: The skill describes analysis, refactor, test, and optimize pipelines.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Check prompts, timeouts, and CLI commands. Review generated plans, tests, and code before applying changes.
